Hide your address from advertising and analytics hosts

Connections to advertising, analytics, attribution and crash-reporting hosts go through the Tor network, so those hosts do not see your address and cannot use it to tell that two apps are the same person. Your network can see that this phone uses Tor. Tor is slower, so a host that sends an app a lot of data is shown your address for 30 minutes and you are told. An app may load slowly or not at all when a host cannot be reached; you are asked then. Everything else stays direct. Nothing is hidden until you continue.
